#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    char* arr = new char[s.length() + 1];
    strcpy(arr, s.c_str());
    int count = 0;
    int i = 0;
    int n = s.length();
    while (i < n) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < n && arr[j] == arr[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
            count++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    delete[] arr;
    return 0;
}
